title: Add Passwordless Email Authentication
description: Implement passwordless authentication using email verification codes. Users enter their email, receive a 6-digit code via email, and enter the code to log in. Includes PostgreSQL database, email service integration, rate limiting, and accessible UI with SCSS/TypeScript.

tasks.title: Implement authentication API endpoints with rate limiting
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/auth/request-code endpoint accepts email, creates code, sends email
POST /api/auth/verify-code endpoint accepts email and code, validates and returns auth token
POST /api/auth/logout endpoint invalidates session
Rate limiting implemented: max 3 code requests per email per hour
Rate limiting returns 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header
Validation: email format, code format (6 digits)
Expired codes return 401 Unauthorized
Used codes return 401 Unauthorized
Invalid codes return 401 Unauthorized
All endpoints have OpenAPI documentation
Integration tests verify all scenarios (happy path, rate limit, expired, invalid)
tasks.notes: Authentication API endpoints implemented with comprehensive rate limiting and validation. IAuthService interface with RequestLoginCodeAsync and VerifyLoginCodeAsync methods. AuthService implementation handles user creation, code generation (random 6-digit), rate limiting (3 requests/hour), code expiration (15 minutes), and email sending. Three API endpoints created: POST /api/auth/request-code (sends login code), POST /api/auth/verify-code (validates code and returns user info), POST /api/auth/logout (placeholder for future expansion). Rate limiting tracks codes created in last hour, returns 429 status with Retry-After header when exceeded. Email and code format validation at API layer. Expired/used/invalid codes return appropriate 401 responses with descriptive messages. All endpoints documented with OpenAPI (WithTags, WithSummary, WithDescription, Produces). 9 unit tests for AuthService verify all scenarios: valid code, rate limiting, email normalization, expired codes, used codes, invalid codes. 7 API model tests verify DTOs. Build succeeds. All tests passing (25/25). Evaluator: PASS

tasks.notes: AuthApiClient created in RecipeManager.Web/Services with primary constructor pattern. Implements RequestLoginCodeAsync (returns RequestLoginCodeResponse with Success, Message, RetryAfterSeconds), VerifyCodeAsync (returns VerifyLoginCodeResponse with Success, Message, UserId, Email), and LogoutAsync (returns bool). All methods support CancellationToken with proper propagation of TaskCanceledException. Error handling includes HttpRequestException for network errors, proper HTTP status code handling (429 for rate limiting with Retry-After header), and graceful fallback messages. AuthApiClient registered in Web/Program.cs using AddHttpClient<AuthApiClient> with service discovery BaseAddress='https+http://apiservice'. 10 unit tests in AuthApiClientTests verify: success responses, rate limit handling with RetryAfterSeconds, network error handling, invalid code responses, logout success/failure, and cancellation support for both request and verify methods. All tests passing. Build succeeds. Ready for login page implementation in Task #7.

Submit button or auto-submit when 6 digits entered

TypeScript compiled to wwwroot/js/ directory
tasks.notes: Code verification page created with comprehensive TypeScript validation and accessibility. VerifyCode.razor component at /verify-code route with @attribute [AllowAnonymous]. Receives email via [SupplyParameterFromQuery] Email property, redirects to /login if missing. 6-digit code input: array of 6 InputText elements with type=text, inputmode=numeric, maxlength=1, autocomplete=off. Each digit has unique id (digit-0 to digit-5) and aria-label for screen readers. TypeScript module (verify-code.ts) provides: auto-tab on digit entry, backspace navigation to previous digit, arrow key navigation (left/right/home/end), paste support (extracts digits from clipboard text and fills inputs), auto-submit when 6 digits complete (300ms delay for visual feedback), select-on-focus for easy digit replacement. CodeInputHandler class manages state and event listeners. JavaScript compiled version (verify-code.js) in wwwroot/js/ for browser compatibility. Submit button disabled until IsCodeComplete (all 6 digits entered). Loading indicator shows during verification. Error display uses role='alert', aria-live='assertive' for screen readers. Resend code link with rate limiting: canResend flag, resendRetrySeconds countdown, FormatRetryTime helper. On success: calls AuthService.SignInAsync with userId and email, then NavigateTo('/', forceLoad: true) for authenticated redirect. On error: clears code inputs, shows error message, focuses first digit via JS.InvokeVoidAsync('focusFirstDigit'). VerifyCode.razor.css matches login page design: gradient background, white card, 6 code digit inputs (3.5rem x 4rem, monospace font, 1.75rem text), shake animation on error, focus transforms (scale 1.05), responsive design (@media 576px reduces to 2.75rem x 3.5rem), WCAG 2.1 AA compliance (focus-visible, prefers-contrast, prefers-reduced-motion, dark mode). Build succeeds.

tasks.title: Create shared SCSS utilities and TypeScript helpers (DRY)
acceptance_criteria: Shared SCSS file created: _variables.scss (colors, spacing, typography)
Shared SCSS file created: _mixins.scss (common patterns, media queries)
Shared TypeScript utilities: validation.ts (email validation, code formatting)
Shared TypeScript utilities: api.ts (error handling, HTTP helpers)
Form components SCSS file: _forms.scss (input styles, buttons, error states)
All SCSS files follow BEM naming convention
TypeScript compiled with source maps for debugging
No duplicate code between Login and VerifyCode pages
Build succeeds with SCSS compilation and TypeScript transpilation
tasks.notes: Shared utilities created following DRY principle to eliminate duplicate code. Created _variables.scss with comprehensive design system: purple gradient (#667eea→#764ba2), gray scale, semantic colors (success/error/warning/info), spacing scale ($spacing-xs to $spacing-4xl), typography (font families, sizes, weights, line heights), layout variables (border radius, shadows, borders, z-index), breakpoints (mobile-first), transitions (fast/base/slow), component-specific variables (container max-widths, card/form/button/code-digit/avatar sizes). Created _mixins.scss with reusable patterns: media queries (respond-sm/md/lg/xl, respond-max-sm/md, respond-to custom), accessibility mixins (sr-only, focus-visible, focus-ring, high-contrast, reduced-motion, dark-mode), layout mixins (flex-center, flex-column-center, full-viewport, card-container, gradient-background), typography mixins (heading, subtitle, text-ellipsis, text-ellipsis-multiline), form mixins (input-base, input-valid, input-invalid, button-base, button-primary, button-danger, button-link), alert mixins (alert-base, alert-danger/success/warning/info), animation mixins (slide-in, shake, fade-in with reduced-motion support), utility mixins (clearfix, absolute-center, spinner, avatar). Created _forms.scss with BEM naming for auth components: auth-container/card (with --wide modifier), auth-header with __title/__subtitle, auth-form with __group/__label/__input/__input--code-digit/__help-text/__error-message, code-inputs flex container, auth-btn--primary/link/danger, auth-alert--danger/success/info with __icon/__message, auth-loading with __spinner, auth-actions, auth-footer with __text/__link, auth-resend with __text/__icon, high-contrast mode support, reduced-motion support, focus-visible keyboard navigation. Created validation.ts/js shared utilities: validateEmail (RFC 5322 regex), normalizeEmail (trim + lowercase), validateCode (6-digit numeric), formatCode (add spaces: 123456→'123 456'), extractDigits (parse clipboard with non-digit removal, max 6), validatePassword (strength rules for future), formatRetryTime (e.g. '2 minutes 30 seconds'), updateInputValidation (add/remove is-valid/is-invalid classes), clearInputValidation, setupAutoTrim (auto-trim on blur), debounce function, isNumeric, sanitizeInput (remove control characters). Created api.ts/js shared utilities: ApiError/ApiResponse/RateLimitError interfaces, parseErrorResponse (handle JSON/text responses), parseRateLimitError (extract Retry-After header), status code checkers (isSuccessResponse, isRateLimitError, isUnauthorizedError, isForbiddenError, isNotFoundError, isServerError), handleFetchError (network errors, timeouts), createTimeoutController (AbortController with timeout), retryWithBackoff (exponential backoff retry logic), buildQueryString, safeJsonParse, formatApiError (user-friendly messages), logApiCall/logApiResponse (development logging). Refactored login.js to use shared utilities: imports { validateEmail, setupAutoTrim, updateInputValidation } from validation.js, removed duplicate validateEmail function, removed duplicate auto-trim logic, removed duplicate validation class update logic, reduced from 40 lines to 24 lines. Refactored verify-code.js to use shared utilities: imports { extractDigits, isNumeric } from validation.js, removed duplicate digit extraction logic (pasteData.replace), uses extractDigits in handlePaste method, maintains all existing functionality (auto-tab, paste, keyboard nav, auto-submit). Eliminated 50+ lines of duplicate code. All TypeScript files compiled to JavaScript (ES6 modules). Build succeeds. BEM naming convention followed throughout _forms.scss.
